paragraphs.en: {Indoor} plants might look as if they just sit around not doing much, but in many ways they are the {unsung} {heroes} of the home.Not only do they look beautiful, but studies have shown that they can promote people's well-being.What's more, indoor plants are easy to look after and are not very {expensive} .
paragraphs.cn: <u> 室内 </u> 植物或许看起来只是默默地待在那里，似乎没什么作用，但在很多方面，它们都是家中 <u> 默默无闻的 </u> “ <u> 英雄 </u> ”。它们不仅外形美观，而且研究表明，它们可以促进人们的身心健康。此外，室内植物很容易打理，而且价格不 <u> 贵 </u> 。

paragraphs.en: Indoor plants are also known as {houseplants} or {pot} plants.A key {criterion} for indoor plants is that they like to grow indoors.Many of these species are not {ideally} suited to growing outside in the UK, especially in the winter.On the {contrary} , they grow better inside, where it is warmer.
paragraphs.cn: 室内植物又称 <u> 家庭盆栽植物 </u> 或 <u> 盆 </u> 栽植物。室内植物的一个重要 <u> 标准 </u> 是它们喜欢在室内生长。在英国，这类植物中的许多品种都不 <u> 太 </u> 适合在室外生长，尤其是在冬季。 <u> 相反 </u> ，它们在更加温暖的室内长得更好。

paragraphs.en: Why are indoor plants good for you?
paragraphs.cn: 为什么室内植物对人有益？

paragraphs.en: Will Spoelstra, who works at the {Royal} {Botanic} Gardens, says,“There are many benefits to growing plants indoors.During the winter months, I've found that having plants around the house can really lift your mood.”A {pretty} plant, when placed in the right spot, can transform an otherwise {plain} space into a {splendid} living area.Tending to plants can offer you a {temporary} {escape} from the busy daily life.Research has also shown that pot plants can clean the surrounding air by absorbing harmful gases like {carbon} {dioxide} .They also remove some harmful chemicals and act as a natural {barrier} to {external} {noises} .Plants like peace {lilies} and devil's {tongue} are among the best in these regards.
paragraphs.cn: 在 <u> 皇家植物 </u> 园工作的威尔·斯波尔斯特拉说：“在室内养植物有很多好处。在冬季的几个月里，我发现在室内摆放植物真的能提升你的情绪。”一株 <u> 漂亮的 </u> 植物，如果摆放在合适的位置，就能将原本 <u> 平淡无奇的 </u> 空间转变成 <u> 美妙的 </u> 生活区域。照料植物可以让你 <u> 暂时 </u> 从繁忙的日常生活中 <u> 解脱 </u> 出来。研究还表明，盆栽植物可以通过吸收 <u> 二氧化碳 </u> 等有害气体来净化周围的空气。它们还能去除一些有害的化学物质，并充当阻挡 <u> 外界噪音 </u> 的天然 <u> 屏障 </u> 。白掌（和平 <u> 百合 </u> ）和魔芋（魔鬼之 <u> 舌 </u> ）等植物是这方面的佼佼者。

paragraphs.en: Aloe vera, peace lilies, {snake} plants and {spider} plants are some of the {outstanding} plants that are easy to grow {indoors} .Thus, they are perfect for those who may {hesitate} to care for {delicate} plants.The aloe vera has {smooth} , {acid} leaves.Inside these leaves is a {gel} that can treat skin irritation ( (炎症) ).The peace lily is well-suited to {damp} environments and, with its small size, fits perfectly into {tight} {apartment} rooms.The snake plant {hardly} requires much attention, although it gives off a {sour} scent, which could be a {minor} drawback.The spider plant has long, striped ( (有条纹的) ) leaves that create a {vivid} contrast in an office space.You can buy plants from {supermarket} {s} , garden centers or online.Younger plants are often {cheaper} than fully {grown} ones.If you decide to {own} plants by {sowing} seeds, you {ought to} carefully care for them as they {mature} , making sure they don't“ {starve} ”from a lack of water or the sunlight they need.
paragraphs.cn: 芦荟、白掌、虎皮兰（ <u> 蛇 </u> 花）和吊兰（ <u> 蜘蛛 </u> 兰）是几种易于 <u> 在 </u> <u> 室内 </u> 种植的 <u> 出色 </u> 植物。因此，它们非常适合那些可能 <u> 不愿意 </u> 照顾 <u> 娇气 </u> 植物的人。芦荟拥有 <u> 光滑的酸性 </u> 叶片。叶片中有可以治疗皮肤炎症的 <u> 凝胶 </u> 。白掌非常适合 <u> 潮湿的 </u> 环境，而且它们体型小巧，很适合 <u> 狭小的公寓 </u> 房间。虎皮兰 <u> 几乎不 </u> 需要太多的照料，不过它会散发出一种 <u> 酸 </u> 味，这可能是一个 <u> 小小的 </u> 缺点。吊兰有着长长的、有条纹的叶子，在办公空间里能形成 <u> 鲜明的 </u> 对比。你可以在 <u> 超市 </u> 、园艺中心或网上购买植物。幼苗通常比 <u> 成熟 </u> 植株更 <u> 便宜 </u> 。如果你决定通过 <u> 播 </u> 种来 <u> 拥有 </u> 植物，那么在它们生长 <u> 成熟 </u> 的过程中，你 <u> 应该 </u> 悉心照料它们，确保它们不会因缺少水或所需的阳光而“ <u> 挨饿 </u> ”。 5NoOncib/NjiX02BpMIzP4m+378Hw1xTRxUdPaP/PFjKUFq4K2G7tp6ZLYoCE601yW1W39VMdLmovFdSHs4nVQ==
